st: Orange County: Extended Stay: Highs and Lows
d: The Emergency Response Team have their hands full of a sadistic murderer who transforms the jail, a roller derby queen who takes a hard fall and one inmate who realizes that even a good day in jail can have a dark side.

Using a form of integration at Indiana State that goes beyond race, the Residential Treatment Unit selects inmates with a history of good behavior to live with and serve as mentors to inmates with mental health issues.

st: Sacramento: Extended Stay: 352,955 Days to Life
d: One inmate contends that a law could put him away forever  an inmate sentenced to life without parole prays that a new law will set him free.

st: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay: Troubled Waters
d: A massive search for contraband throughout the facility turns up the heat on two inmates inside the Santa Rosa Correctional Institution  a convict prompts an evacuation when he floods his housing unit.

st: Oakland: Extended Stay: Wait of the World
d: A violent gang member asks to move back to general population, following six years in segregation  a brother and sister are charged with murdering a high school football star, two years after he was stabbed to death on an Oakland street corner.

st: Colorado: Extended Stay: There Goes the Neighborhood
d: Welcome to Limon Correctional Facility, a level 4 prison that houses many of Colorado's most dangerous inmates  while visiting Limon Correctional, the Lockup crew is greeted by angry inmates and the cell extraction team is called in to help.

t: Lockup Special Investigation: Lake County Juvenile Justice
d: For some kids, the revolving door of lockup seems to snag one generation after the next  17-year-old Kenneth and 14-year-old Kentrell have 10 brothers and sisters, a father in prison and a mother with a criminal record for public nuisance.

t: Lockup Special Investigation: Lake County Juvenile Justice
d: More than three thousand kids pass through the juvenile courts in Lake County, Indiana each year  here, consequences can range from a sleepless night in detention to the ultimate punishment for kids who keep coming back: Boys' School.
